scenario.summary: Guest opens a simple product with a checkbox add-on group (sheet column AddonCheckboxAsRequired), verifies its PDP details, then adds it to the cart three times, each time with a different add-on, checks the cart count and empties the cart.
steps: Open the webstore, search the product SKU and open its PDP
Verify name, SKU, brand, short description, price, special offers title, quantity validations
Verify the add-on options label and add-on type label
Verify the Details, Specification and Shipping tabs and the Write a Review link
Verify the add-on option names and prices list
Select add-on 1, Add to Cart, close the notification, verify cart count
Repeat with add-on 2 and add-on 3 (cart count +1, +2)
stateChanges: Guest cart: the product is added three times (once per add-on), then all cart items are removed
assertions: Product name, 'SKU:\n<sku>', brand (skipped on multistore12 centralized login), short description and price match the product
SPECIAL PRICE OFFERS title, Read Reviews link, quantity box default 1
Blank quantity shows 'Please enter a numeric value.'; quantity 0 shows 'Please specify valid product quantity.'
Details, Specification and Shipping tabs show the product's texts
Each listed add-on option shows '<name> <price>' of the product's add-ons
Add to Cart notification appears and the header cart count goes up after each add
evidence: Independent method (no dependsOn); linked manual cases Z10-TC-7679, 7680, 7709, 7710, 8876, 8873 are in the class comment, not in the scan.

Key PRODUCT_SIMPLE_WITH_ADDON_IN_STOCK (approved, used by the Playwright simple pdp entry): active published in-stock simple product with an add-on group of the given display type; it returns every PDP text the method checks. addOnDisplayType CheckBox (stored ZnodePimAddonGroup.DisplayType).

Read by the page object, not scanned: ProductDisplayPage.verifySimpleProductDetails(pdpDataMap, '<column>') reads ProductSKU, ProductName, Brand, ShortDescription, ProductPrice, AddOnType, ProductDetails, ProductSpecification and Shipping of the method's column (a variable column key the scanner cannot follow) -> product.sku, name, brandName, shortDescription, price (Tda.money), addOnGroupName, details, specifications, shippingInfo. No source entries: the cells are not in the scan and the workbook is not read; so no preferred record (the sheet SKU is not a source).

Gap (params): the method selects three add-on products in turn; the key guarantees at least one add-on of the display type (addOnCount >= 1), so a fallback product may have fewer (addOn2Name/addOn3Name null). Proposal (not written): optional param minAddOnOptions on PRODUCT_SIMPLE_WITH_ADDON_IN_STOCK (left out = any), so existing requirements keep their rows.
quantityUsed 3: the product is added three times at quantity 1 (one cart line per add-on), so the cart holds 3 units of it; the cart is emptied at the end (Remove All).

verifyProductDefaultImage / verifyThumbnailImages call BasePage.verifyImageEquals, whose body is commented out and always returns true: no data need (as decided for shoppingCart: image checks structural).
The add-ons are clicked by name (checkbox label contains the text): AddOnFirst/Second/ThirdProduct -> product.addOn1Name / addOn2Name / addOn3Name (display order; the test only needs each to exist).

Not scanned: TestData.getHashMap tables are not in the scan. verifySimpleProductAddonsDetails(checkboxAddOnsDataMap) compares every add-on option on the PDP with sheet rows AddOnOption0..n (name and price). They are values of this method's needs and must come from the resolved record when the class is migrated (product.addOn1Name/addOn1Price .. addOn3Name/addOn3Price); check-hardcoded cannot see them today.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware; centralizedLoginEnabled=no), the same store as the Playwright webstore entries. Guest flow, no sign-in (the CentralizedLogin group is a tag only; no login call in the method).
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); sheet SKUs were looked up read-only with bin/tda rows (2026-11-06) where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, map key prefixes) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap / getHashMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
